searchText: So far daily on average more than one validator is being slashed. Is it making a dent in the inflation rate? What's the issuance rate now? There are 900 validators onboarding everyday, the impact of that is much higher than the lonely slashed validator. Issuance today, annualized it's about 11% 11% would be the interest generated by each validator by the moment all validators leave queue and are active. The actual issuance should be different. Well considering only validators are in Eth2 right now, I think 11% would be accurate, if only going by percent Yes I'm counting with everyone in the queue entering and noone else and averaging by the fact that we got above 14 for a month The absolute maximum if no more deposits enter will be about 11 hence my sentence I do expect to be about 8 though And I don't expect it to get below 6 cause i would suspect there'll be far less risky Defi projects returning more Interest rates on ETH in Defi tend to be low, unless it's tokenized version of Eth2 staking. The supply of people wanting interest on ETH tends to be much higher than the people wanting to borrow ETH to short it Issuance is running at somewhere around 450 Ether per day, and a single slashed validator loses around 1.5 Ether over its slashing period, so not really. <@!144468805697929216> I see. I thought they would lose more than that. On the back of my envelope, I make it about 0.6 ETH total for getting slashed in the current regime: 0.25 initial penalty, and then about 36 days of leakage give another 0.34 ETH. The other correlation slashing penalty should round down to zero as not many validators have been slashed yet. Yeah, Ben is correct. I was thinking that the initial penalty was still in the 1 Ether range, but it was reduced for the first few months of mainnet.
